notes.md: - **SECs of other States:** **Madhya Pradesh** SEC constituted **1 February 1994** (first Commissioner N.B. Lohani from 15 February 1994); **Rajasthan** SEC constituted in **July 1994** under Article 243K.

new.s: How many mandals does Andhra Pradesh have under its Panchayati Raj structure (May 2026)?
new.x: AP's PR structure has about 15,000+ Gram Panchayats, 588 mandals and 13 Zilla Parishads (May 2026).
new.angle: U0355 notes gap: AP 588 mandals

new.s: On which date was the Andhra Pradesh Panchayat Raj Act, 1994, the conformity Act under the 73rd Amendment, enacted?
new.x: The AP Panchayat Raj Act, 1994 (Act No. 13 of 1994) was enacted on 21 April 1994 to conform to the 73rd Amendment.
new.angle: U0355 notes gap: AP PR Act 21 April 1994

new.s: Who appoints the State Election Commissioner under Article 243K?
new.x: Under Article 243K the State Election Commissioner is appointed by the Governor of the State.
new.angle: U0355 notes gap: SEC appointed by Governor

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the State Election Commissioner:
1. He is appointed by the Governor.
2. His conditions of service cannot be varied to his disadvantage after appointment.
3. He can be removed by the Governor on the advice of the State Finance Commission.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The Governor appoints the SEC, whose service conditions cannot be varied to his disadvantage; he is removed only like a High Court judge, and the SFC has no such role.
new.angle: U0355 notes gap: SEC appointment and service conditions

new.s: In how many States does the PESA Act, 1996 extend Part IX to Fifth Schedule Areas?
new.x: PESA applies to the Fifth Schedule Areas of ten States, including Andhra Pradesh.
new.angle: U0355 notes gap: PESA in ten States

new.s: In K. Krishna Murthy v. Union of India (2010), what did the Supreme Court hold about backwardness for reservation in local bodies?
o: Political backwardness is not the same as social and educational backwardness
OBC reservation in local bodies is unconstitutional
Reservation in local bodies may exceed 50 per cent as a rule
Only economic backwardness can be the basis
new.x: The Court upheld Articles 243D(6)/243T(6) and held that political backwardness differs from social and educational backwardness, with total reservation normally within 50%.
new.angle: U0355 notes gap: Krishna Murthy - political vs social backwardness

new.s: Which category of the National Panchayat Awards is the Deen Dayal Upadhyay Panchayat Satat Vikas Puraskar given for?
new.x: The Deen Dayal Upadhyay Puraskar is theme-wise; the Nanaji Deshmukh Sarvottam Puraskar is the overall award.
new.angle: U0355 notes gap: Deen Dayal Upadhyay award = theme-wise

new.s: What is 'Meri Panchayat'?
o: A drone survey scheme for Records of Rights
A mobile app of the Ministry of Panchayati Raj for citizens
An AI tool for Gram Sabha minutes
A 2023 app recording Gram Sabha decisions
new.x: Meri Panchayat is the MoPR mobile app for citizens; SVAMITVA is drone mapping, SabhaSaar the AI tool and GS NIRNAY the Gram Sabha decisions app.
new.angle: U0355 notes gap: Meri Panchayat app

new.s: In which month and year was the State Election Commission of Rajasthan constituted under Article 243K?
new.x: The Rajasthan State Election Commission was constituted in July 1994 under Article 243K.
new.angle: U0355 web: #21 Rajasthan SEC constituted July 1994

new.s: When was the Madhya Pradesh State Election Commission constituted?
new.x: The MP State Election Commission was constituted by notification on 1 February 1994; its first Commissioner N.B. Lohani took office on 15 February 1994.
new.angle: U0355 web: #21 MP SEC constituted 1 February 1994

new.s: Which Article of the Constitution provides for reservation of seats in Municipalities?
new.x: Article 243T deals with reservation of seats in Municipalities; 243D is its Panchayat counterpart.
new.angle: U0356 notes gap: Article 243T reservation

new.s:
Match the following:
List-I (Subject)
a. Reservation
b. Duration
c. Audit
d. State Election Commission
List-II (Article for Municipalities)
1. 243Z
2. 243ZA

new.s: Which Union Ministry is the main ministry for urban local bodies in India?
o: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
new.x: MoHUA is the main ministry for ULBs; Home Affairs handles ULBs in Union Territories and Defence handles Cantonment Boards.
new.angle: U0356 notes gap: MoHUA main ministry for ULBs

new.s: Which State has the largest Scheduled Tribe population in India (Census 2011)?
new.x: Madhya Pradesh has the largest tribal population; the Bhil is the largest tribe.
new.angle: U0357 notes gap: largest ST population - MP

new.s: About how many Scheduled Tribe groups are notified in India?
new.x: There are 705 notified ST groups, forming 8.6% of the population (Census 2011).
new.angle: U0357 notes gap: 705 ST groups

new.s: Which Article of the Constitution makes special provision for Manipur, including a committee of members from its hill areas?
new.x: Article 371C is for Manipur (hill-area committee); 371A is for Nagaland and 244A for an autonomous State in Assam.
new.angle: U0357 notes gap: Article 371C Manipur hill areas

new.s: In which district of Andhra Pradesh are the Paderu, Rampachodavaram and Chintoor ITDAs located?
new.x: Paderu, Rampachodavaram and Chintoor ITDAs are in Alluri Sitharama Raju district; Seethampeta and Parvathipuram are in Manyam, KR Puram in Eluru.
new.angle: U0357 notes gap: Paderu/Rampachodavaram/Chintoor ITDAs - ASR district

new.s: At which place did Jawaharlal Nehru inaugurate Panchayati Raj on 2 October 1959?
new.x: Nehru inaugurated Panchayati Raj at Nagaur in Rajasthan on 2 October 1959, not Jaipur.
new.angle: U0358 notes gap: PR inaugurated at Nagaur

new.s: Who inaugurated Panchayati Raj at Nagaur in Rajasthan on 2 October 1959?
new.x: Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru inaugurated Panchayati Raj at Nagaur on 2 October 1959.
new.angle: U0358 notes gap: Nehru inaugurated PR

new.s: Which body accepted the recommendations of the Balwant Rai Mehta Committee in January 1958?
new.x: The Balwant Rai Mehta Committee (1957) report was accepted by the National Development Council in January 1958.
new.angle: U0358 notes gap: BRM report accepted by NDC 1958

new.s: Which committee recommended the official participation of political parties at all levels of Panchayati Raj elections?
new.x: The Ashok Mehta Committee (1977-78) recommended party participation, two tiers and compulsory taxation powers.
new.angle: U0358 notes gap: Ashok Mehta - party participation

new.s: How is the Sarpanch of a Gram Panchayat elected in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Under the AP Panchayat Raj Act, 1994, the Sarpanch is directly elected; MPP Presidents and ZP Chairpersons are elected indirectly.
new.angle: U0358 notes gap: Sarpanch directly elected in AP

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the AP Panchayat Raj Act, 1994:
1. MPTC members are directly elected.
2. ZPTC members are directly elected.
3. The Mandal Parishad President is directly elected by the voters.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: MPTC and ZPTC members are directly elected, but the MPP President is elected indirectly from among the MPTC members.
new.angle: U0358 notes gap: MPTC/ZPTC direct election

new.s: How much has been allotted to the rural local bodies of Andhra Pradesh under the 16th Finance Commission (AP Budget 2026-27)?
new.x: The AP Budget 2026-27 shows Rs 16,627 crore for rural local bodies under the 16th FC (2026-31); Rs 12,150 crore is at risk if polls slip.
new.angle: U0358 notes gap: 16th FC Rs 16,627 crore for AP rural local bodies

new.s: Since which year has Mee Seva, the single-window citizen service counter, functioned in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Mee Seva has provided single-window citizen services in AP since 2011.
new.angle: U0358 notes gap: Mee Seva since 2011

new.s: In which year did Women and Child Development become a separate Union Ministry?
new.x: WCD became a separate ministry in 2006, the same year Minority Affairs was carved out.
new.angle: U0359 notes gap: WCD separate ministry 2006

new.s: In which year was the Ministry of Welfare, later renamed the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, created?
new.x: The Ministry of Welfare was created in 1985 and renamed Social Justice and Empowerment in 1998.
new.angle: U0359 notes gap: Ministry of Welfare 1985

new.s: NITI Aayog released the second India Electric Mobility Index in September 2026 together with which organisation?
new.x: NITI Aayog brought out the second India Electric Mobility Index with WRI India on 17 September 2026.
new.angle: U0359 notes gap: India Electric Mobility Index - NITI Aayog with WRI India

new.s: The Minimum Wages Act, 1948 is an example of which type of social legislation?
new.x: The Minimum Wages Act, 1948 is regulatory social legislation; the Factories Act, 1948 is protective.
new.angle: U0359 notes gap: Minimum Wages Act regulatory

new.s: In which year did NITI Aayog replace the Planning Commission?
new.x: NITI Aayog was set up in 2015, replacing the Planning Commission of 1950.
new.angle: U0360 notes gap: NITI Aayog 2015

new.s: Who led the Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan (MKSS), whose campaign in Rajasthan led to the RTI Act, 2005?
new.x: The MKSS, led by Aruna Roy in Rajasthan, ran the right-to-information campaign behind the RTI Act, 2005.
new.angle: U0360 notes gap: MKSS - Aruna Roy

new.s: Which case laid down the basic structure limit on Parliament's power to amend the Constitution under Article 368?
new.x: Kesavananda Bharati held that an amendment under Article 368 cannot alter the basic structure.
new.angle: U0360 notes gap: amendment limited by basic structure - Kesavananda Bharati
